description: Header file defining the QuicSimpleServer class, a toy QUIC server implementation that listens on a specified address, handles incoming QUIC traffic, and manages server state and connections.

classes.name: QuicSimpleServer
classes.description: A simple QUIC server class that manages listening, connection handling, and server lifecycle.

methods.name: QuicSimpleServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server with configuration, proof source, supported versions, and backend.

methods.name: CreateUDPSocketAndListen
methods.description: Creates a UDP socket and starts listening on the specified address.

methods.name: HandleEventsForever
methods.description: Handles events in a loop indefinitely.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Starts listening on the given address, returns true if successful.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Prepares the server for shutdown and cleanup.

methods.name: StartReading
methods.description: Begins reading from the socket, setting up asynchronous read callbacks.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of an asynchronous read.
